mapper.sql: id, given_name, family_name, dob, nationality, passport_no, email, phone, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select from nad_applicant where id in #{x} order by family_name, given_name, id
mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant (given_name, family_name, dob, nationality, passport_no, email, phone, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{givenName}, #{familyName}, #{dob}, #{nationality}, #{passportNo}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update nad_applicant set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, applicant_id, institution, level, field, gpa, gpa_scale, start_date, end_date from nad_applicant_education where applicant_id = #{applicantId} order by end_date desc, id desc
select id, applicant_id, institution, level, field, gpa, gpa_scale, start_date, end_date from nad_applicant_education where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_education (applicant_id, institution, level, field, gpa, gpa_scale, start_date, end_date, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{institution}, #{level}, #{field}, #{gpa}, #{gpaScale}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, '', now())
mapper.update: update nad_applicant_education set institution = #{institution}, level = #{level}, field = #{field}, gpa = #{gpa}, gpa_scale = #{gpaScale}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.delete: delete from nad_applicant_education where id = #{id} and applicant_id = #{applicantId}

mapper.update: update nad_applicant_test_score set test_type = #{testType}, score = #{score}, sub_scores_json = #{subScoresJson}, taken_on = #{takenOn}, expires_on = #{expiresOn}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.delete: delete from nad_applicant_test_score where id = #{id} and applicant_id = #{applicantId}
